channel.title: Just the News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just the News (justthenews.com)

item.title: White House confirms Trump floated renaming Dulles airport, Penn Station after himself
item.description: The White House appeared to clarify that it was Trump who floated the idea when discussing the restoration of $16 billion in federal funds that was previously designated for the Gateway rail tunnel project.

item.title: Authorities detain person for questioning in Nancy Guthrie disappearance
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, 84, has been missing since around noon Feb. 1 after she did not show up for virtual church services

item.title: Michigan sued for forcing pro-life groups to hire pro-abortion staff, provide abortion insurance
item.description: Federal appeals court reinstated lawsuit against New York's similar law a year ago. Michigan pro-life pregnancy center fears it can't even deny volunteers who support abortion, under public accommodation law.

item.title: Legal experts warn repeal of climate rule will need good strategies to survive activist lawsuits
item.description: The Trump administration will likely repeal the so-called "endangerment finding," which has been the basis for a host of climate policies coming out of the EPA. Climate groups will surely attack the final rule in court. Legal experts say the administration needs to strategize if it's going to withstand the litigation.

item.title: Lawmaker probing J6 is worried U.S. Capitol Police intelligence was politicized against Republicans
item.description: Chairman Barry Loudermilk, Chairman of the Select Subcommittee on January 6, said he is concerned that Democrats used the department to gather information on Republican lawmakers concurrent with the Justice Department’s wider probe into Trump over January 6.

item.title: Academics from China who attended Chinese military-run schools work at U.S. colleges and labs
item.description: Graduates of China's "Seven Sons" defense universities found perches for themselves at U.S. colleges and research labs, and many have access to valuable intellectual property.

item.title: Nine dead, dozens wounded in shootings at Canadian high school, residence
item.description: The police said approximately 25 people are being assessed and triaged at a local medical center for non‑life‑threatening injuries, and two victims have been airlifted to hospital with serious or life‑threatening injuries.

item.title: Report shows that rising health care costs could affect midterm elections
item.description: President Donald Trump (62%), Democrats (63%) and Republicans (64%) in Congress all received nearly two-thirds votes of "not too much" confidence to "no" confidence to address the general cost of living.

item.title: Colorado Dems pushing 2 new bills that would add rules for gun stores, ban 3D-printed firearms
item.description: Both bills, introduced by Democrats in the state legislature last week, are in addition to two other bills lawmakers are considering that would expand the state’s “Red Flag” law and require any gun barrel purchases to be made from a firearm dealer.

item.title: GOP lawmakers pushing 3 federal election security bills
item.description: “I think we can trust the outcome of the election, but what I will tell you is that there is still a great concern that in certain pockets of the country, that there’s not strict enforcement of the laws,” U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., told reporters Tuesday.
